title: Attack
text: “E-everything…? Yes.”
“That’s right. Without exception, I’m buying up every single Filolial Aria-species egg. Here’s all the gold I’ve got.”
With that, I plopped the money bag I’d received in Siltvelt down in front of the Monster Merchant.
“You should even get some change back.”
It’s all gold coins inside. If there’s anything I can’t buy with this, I’ll just go back to Siltvelt and get more. And if that still isn’t enough, I’ll just hunt down some bandits to raise the funds.
“T-these are coins from the Kingdom of Siltvelt, aren’t they? Yes.”
“Is that a problem?”
“N-no, we do business across national borders, so it’s not a problem. However, since we’re in Melromarc, we’ll have to value them a bit lower—is that all right? Yes.”
“That’s fine.”
“Then, I’ll provide all the Filolial Aria-species eggs I have available. Yes.”

The monster merchant’s subordinate checks the gold coins and lets out a gasp of surprise. The monster merchant himself seems so astonished he’s lost for words. After a short while, a handcart fully loaded with the Filolial-sama eggs was brought over.
“These are all the Filolial Aria-species eggs we have in stock. Yes.”
“Nothing left out, I presume?”
“None at all. Yes. This includes everything, even the prizes from the egg gacha. Yes.”
Hmm… That means there’s bound to be an egg in here that will hatch into Filo-tan! I was filled with joy.
“That was a great purchase.”
“How would you like us to handle the monster mark registration and arranging the incubator? Yes.”
“That’s no problem.”
Siltvelt will take care of that for me.
“Well then, that was a great purchase. Farewell.”
“Thank you very much. Yes. …Since there’s a possibility we might be suspected of colluding with a wanted criminal, we’ll be closing up shop for a while. Yes.”

I skipped out of the tent. There’s a mountain of eggs. I can’t transport them all through the portal like this. What should I do? Maybe I’ll divide them up at a safe spot and transport them through the portal in smaller batches. With that in mind, I walked along with a smug grin on my face, pushing the handcart I’d bought on the side.

I’ll divide Filolial-sama’s eggs into smaller bags and transport them to Siltvelt via the portal. Of course, learning from past mistakes, this Motoyasu is managing the Melromarc portals thoroughly. Normally, you can only acquire four portals, but thanks to Skills-based enhancements and a special boost from the Seven Stars, the number of portals increases dramatically. Plus, they’re much easier to manage now.
Well, once I finished transporting all the eggs to Siltvelt and registered them and prepared for hatching, that was the end of the day.
“Right then.”

Having finished organizing the eggs, I set out to settle some old scores without reporting to my Father. That is… to crush the Three Heroes Church and the Trash in Melromarc! Ren had also mentioned some suspicious activity, so it’s best to take care of these troublemakers first.
“Brionac!”

That night… I stormed the Three Heroes Church in Melromarc’s town square, unleashing Skills right at its front entrance. With a deafening roar, I blasted through the church doors. As soon as I stepped inside, the priests and nuns of the Three Heroes Church, having heard the commotion, rushed over. They’re all guilty as well. Their crime of sitting idly by while plotting against Father’s life—they deserve to die a thousand deaths!
“Who are you?!”
“I am The Love Hunter! For a reason of my own, I have come to teach the Three Heroes Church the folly of impeaching my Father!”
“What!?”
“Aiming Lancer V!”
I used Multi-Lock to lock onto as many of the foolish cultists right in front of me as possible. The Skills activated, and I began to wipe out the cultists.
“Guh!”
“Gyaaaah!”
“Hahahahaha! One must nip the seeds of future anxiety in the bud!”
Well, I am holding back just enough so they don’t actually die. But they’d long since crossed the line of what I could tolerate.
“Where is the Pope?”

I pointed my spear at the priest, who was begging for his life, and issued a warning. I’m just instilling in these scoundrels the terror that it would be better to die than to disobey Father’s order not to kill. Depending on the time and circumstances, I’d have no qualms about reducing the Pope himself to a pile of charcoal.
“I won’t speak to the Devil!”
“Then shall I tear that mouth of yours apart?”

I twisted the tip of the spear into the priest’s mouth and slowly moved it to the right. This spear is a legendary weapon forged from twelve enhancements and the corpses of countless monsters. It would tear through human flesh with ease.
“If you don’t talk, you’ll suffer.”
“S-stop itttttttttttttttttttttt!”

Eventually, the priest confessed. True to form for a self-serving cultist—he gave in easily. Love is accepting even death for the sake of those who truly believe. For the sake of Father and Filo-tan, I wouldn’t hesitate to give my life, even if I had regrets.
“T-The Pope has left the country! He’s not here!”

Hmm… It’s a bit suspicious, but since he’s not in this building, it must be true. I drew my spear and smashed the priest’s head with all my might, knocking him unconscious. Well, now that he’s realized he was completely helpless against a head-on assault, he’ll probably calm down a bit.
As for the rest…
“The Spear Demon is heading for the castle!”
“Hurry up and set up the defensive line!”

After destroying the Three Heroes Church, I walk through the town of Melromarc toward the castle. Soldiers band together to attack me, but they’re no match for me. I tear them apart and toss them aside, over and over, knocking them down just enough to keep them from dying.
“Whoa, what incredible strength!”
“Aiming Lancer X!”
“Guhahaaaaaa!”
“Gyaaaaaaa—”

While mowing down the attacking soldiers, I cast fire magic to extinguish the flames in the town—which the foolish soldiers had turned into a sea of fire with their own spells. If I can control fire, I can also put it out. Well, it’s quite difficult, but I didn’t come here to wage war. I’m just here to teach those foolish fools—who don’t know their place and are trying to kill the Hero—a lesson in humility.
“Now then… where are Trash and Bitch?”

I’ll use Skills to blast through the closed castle gates and storm in head-on. As I walk slowly through the castle, soldiers swarm out from all directions only to be cut down one after another. I wish they’d realize how much of a hassle it is to hold back. Do they even understand that a castle of this caliber would fall with just a few powerful Magic spells fired from the outside?
“Trash and Bitch… where are the king and princess? I, Motoyasu, have come to teach you a lesson—just enough to keep me alive.”

With that, I passed through the throne room and headed to Trash’s bedroom and Bitch’s room, but they were nowhere to be seen. Just as I’d expect from Trash and Bitch. They sure are quick on their feet.
“Oh! The King and Princess have left the country with their army! They’re not here!”

A man who looked like a minister said this while begging for his life. Hmm… This is what you’d call a wasted effort. What a hassle… Well, at least this should teach them a lesson about their place to some extent.
“Then report this immediately. If you pull any unnecessary stunts, I can take your lives just like that. Make sure you understand your place… Hahahahahaha!”
Ignoring the lot of them as they groaned in frustration, I returned via the portal.
“Welcome back, Motoyasu-kun.”
When I returned to Siltvelt that night, my Father was there to greet me at Siltvelt Castle.
“Where have you been? There are a bunch of eggs in the castle storeroom… You’re not planning on eating them, are you?”
“They’re all Filolial-sama’s eggs, you know.”
“Ah, I figured as much.”
“Our ranks will grow.”
“It’s going to get noisy! Kou, I’m looking forward to it!”
“Hmm? Either way, Sakura will protect Naofumi, right?”
“Thank you, Sakura-chan. So, Motoyasu-kun, you bought a huge amount this time. Is it in preparation for the wave?”
“Filo-tan should be in there somewhere.”
“Ah… so that’s what it’s about.”

As my father-in-law watches with half-closed eyes, Sakura-chan hugs him from behind and climbs up onto his back. It’s a truly heartwarming sight. But as for me, Motoyasu, just thinking about being reunited with Filo-tan makes my heart race.
“While I was at it, I stormed into the Three Heroes Church and the castle in Melromarc to teach them a lesson about knowing their place.”
“Huh? You just casually mentioned something outrageous, didn’t you? What did you do? Do you realize that this could easily lead to war?”

After that, my Father spent several hours making requests of me. Well, “requests” might be a stretch—toward the end, it was more of a commanding tone, telling me not to do anything unnecessary. This was, as they say, a lecture. I, Motoyasu, am full of remorse for all my shortcomings.
“Actually… we’re supposed to be looking for the Claw Hero, but it feels like you, Motoyasu, have absolutely no intention of looking for him…”
“Preparation is important.”

“Well, that is your job, after all. With this many Filolial eggs, we can use a human wave tactic. It seems the people of Siltvelt are also in the middle of searching, coordinating with all relevant parties.”
